title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How to Handle the Proposal to Suspend Enforcement Made by the People's Procuratorate

articles.content_en:
Fa Shi [2000] No. 16

Guangdong Higher People's Court:

We have received your Request for Instructions on Whether to Accept the Suggestion of the Procuratorial Organ to Suspend Enforcement of an Effective Civil Judgment of the Court (Yue Gao Fa Min [1998] No. 186). Upon study, we reply as follows:

Pursuant to the provisions of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, there is no legal basis for the People's Procuratorate to propose a suggestion to suspend the enforcement of an effective civil judgment of the People's Court.

It is so replied.
